scope: persistence, recovery, cleanup, and resource custody
release, packaging, evidence, and independent acceptance
authority: Internal implementation audit. It may establish reproducible defects and repair evidence, but it cannot self-accept findings reserved for an independent auditor or override Codex host safety controls.

findings.title: Security metadata search emits raw capability descriptions by default
findings.evidence: runtime/cybersecurity_provider.py search results include the complete external description even though selection remains metadata-only. Broad diagnostic output surfaced restricted vocabulary into the chat transcript and triggered host cybersecurity safeguards.
findings.required_outcome: Default search output is payload-minimized while ranking may still use descriptions internally; full descriptions require an explicit opt-in and never grant authority.
findings.repair_evidence: Default security-capability search returned three candidates in 2,391 bytes with descriptions_included=false, zero description fields, and authority_granted=false; targeted provider and CLI tests passed.

findings.title: Bounded startup performs an eager 5,000-file tooling walk
findings.evidence: runtime.cli startup measured about 326 ms and returned tooling_assessment.inventory.examined_files=5000, truncated=true, source_files=0. The scan runs despite a separate explicit tooling command and traverses operational/untracked trees before useful source.
findings.required_outcome: Startup remains metadata-only and defers project tooling inventory to the explicit tooling command.
findings.repair_evidence: Seven clean process runs had a 212.9 ms median; tooling_deferred=true, hydrated_skill_bodies=[], and no inventory was present.

findings.title: Current-head consumers perform full forensic event replay
findings.evidence: OperationalEventBus.replay(limit=1) validated 1,196 historical events and took about 991 ms. Provider, runtime-lifecycle, and agent publication paths use replay only to obtain the current digest.
findings.required_outcome: Provide a fail-closed anchored-head read for hot paths while retaining explicit full replay for forensic verification and session reconstruction.
findings.repair_evidence: Anchored head verification passed at revision 1,224 in 60.6 ms; full replay independently verified the complete 1,224-event prefix. Hot publication call sites use head(), while replay remains the forensic owner.

findings.title: Committed WAL custody amplifies every operational event into many retained files
findings.evidence: The live operation bus contains 1,196 events but 11,958 committed WAL files and 15,550 total files. Retention is evidentiary, but no compaction or archive lifecycle is declared.
findings.required_outcome: Define and implement hash-preserving committed-WAL archival/retention without weakening recovery or deleting evidence.
findings.repair_evidence: A dry-run-first archive gate sealed 1,024 committed transactions with member hashes and a recovery receipt, retained 200 live transactions, reduced live WAL files from 12,227 to 2,002, and preserved valid head, full replay, and WAL recovery.

findings.title: Runtime-owned and portable-runtime trees pollute Git/context discovery
findings.evidence: Git reports 23,272 untracked files: 16,479 under .engineering-bootstrap, including 15,550 operation-bus files, and 2,718 under Python. VS Code exclusions exist, but Git/Codex discovery still enumerates them because repository ignore rules do not.
findings.required_outcome: Exclude non-source runtime custody and the portable Python installation from Git/context discovery without deleting or hiding authoritative source/evidence required for audit.
findings.repair_evidence: Repository ignore boundaries now exclude the portable runtime and high-churn PX custody trees; untracked discovery dropped from 23,272 to roughly 4,521 without deleting canonical skills or evidence.

findings.title: PX Doctor is operable but not ready or certification-ready
findings.evidence: Doctor reports overall_state=degraded with four coverage blockers: missing current health states for extension.vscode-listener, provider.remote-model, provider.local-model, and runtime.package-environment. Extension host health is unobserved and two Tier-D/observer blind spots remain visible.
findings.required_outcome: Live producers publish fresh, scope-correct health evidence or the routes are truthfully marked optional/unadvertised; Doctor must not infer health.
findings.repair_evidence: Exact VSIX d5f2c3dc451e159510d708489fb82a0fb0f2dd6c780113746e2ee9e0ce774c39 passed a clean-profile VS Code 1.132.1 smoke: listener status healthy, complete available-route coverage, zero drops, engine connected, sidebar resolved with zero contract rejections, dashboard counts matched, graph rendered, and the owned host process tree closed.

findings.title: Environment and handoff evidence is stale relative to the active build
findings.evidence: Doctor reads environment evidence from 2026-08-11 and a handoff generated 2026-08-12 while evaluating the 2026-08-14 build, yet labels the section healthy because presence and schema pass.
findings.required_outcome: Freshness affects readiness and stale evidence is regenerated or reported stale rather than healthy.
findings.repair_evidence: Doctor now reports environment_stale, accepts both current environment schemas, and proves the older handoff current through an exact coordination state-hash match. An explicitly approved bounded refresh persisted schema 2.0 generation 1 with zero failures/ambiguities and snapshot hash 6657c790eb5aab79aae1fa364fc4ccb6153b83f1b5a2143c1df35c11736587a1.

findings.title: Route registry validation is repeated on every event publication
findings.evidence: OperationalEventBus._route_tier validates and reloads the entire route registry for each event. Extension batch publication therefore repeats identical source validation under the publication lock.
findings.required_outcome: Use hash-aware validated metadata caching with invalidation on registry identity change.
findings.repair_evidence: OperationalEventBus caches validated route tiers by size, mtime_ns, and ctime_ns and reloads fail-closed when registry identity changes; operational event-bus tests passed.

findings.title: Large default audit output causes context and latency pressure
findings.evidence: A valid structure audit emitted roughly 3,199 lines, including every accepted duplicate projection group, although the operational decision required only category status and exceptions.
findings.required_outcome: Provide a bounded summary mode and retain detailed records as file evidence rather than flooding interactive transcripts.
findings.repair_evidence: Structure audit --summary emitted 34 lines and about 1.2 KB instead of roughly 3,199 lines while the default complete report remains available.

findings.title: Independent audit acceptance remains open
findings.evidence: registry/completion_status.json retains 39 pending IDs: 34 adversarial, 3 functional, and 2 operational. Internal gates cannot self-accept these findings.
findings.required_outcome: Supply a clean exact-artifact audit handoff and retain the gate until an independent verifier accepts or contradicts each finding.

findings.title: Repository state is too noisy for an independently attributable release candidate
findings.evidence: Doctor reports 1,152 tracked changes and 23,272 untracked files. Many changes are intentional migration work, but a clean immutable source identity cannot be inferred from this workspace state.
findings.required_outcome: Package a deterministic clean handoff with complete byte manifest and explicitly separate internal source certification from independent release acceptance.

findings.title: Governed tests inherited the operator's real host authority-key location
findings.evidence: Agent-runtime tests attempted to create prepared authority keys below the real LOCALAPPDATA host key root, causing permission failures and risking test interaction with operator-owned authority material.
findings.required_outcome: Every governed pytest run receives an isolated authority-key root inside its registered and reclaimed temporary workspace unless the caller supplies a narrower test root.
findings.repair_evidence: The testing-governance section passed 65 tests and 9 subtests; its nested pytest test wrote a test-only key below the managed temporary authority root and the complete workspace was reclaimed.

findings.title: Synthetic repository clones attempted to copy protected Git authentication keys
findings.evidence: Release and portability fixtures recursively copied the live .git directory and failed on .git/pacify-x-auth private keys.
findings.required_outcome: Synthetic product fixtures exclude repository metadata and host authentication material while retaining the PX state explicitly required by the test.
findings.repair_evidence: Portability integrity passed 27 tests, release build passed 81 tests, and exact-installed passed 21 tests without reading or copying protected Git keys.

findings.title: Recoverable archival tools were not admitted by the effect-surface policy
findings.evidence: The effect validator rejected the WAL and project-map archive tools solely because their verified archive-then-reclaim flow uses shutil.rmtree outside the generic resource-lifecycle module.
findings.required_outcome: Admit only the two named recoverable-reclamation owners under the operational evidence retention policy and continue rejecting every unadmitted delete surface.
findings.repair_evidence: Derived integrity passed the admitted archive owners and a new adversarial test proved an arbitrary unlink remains prohibited.

findings.title: Windows persisted-process reconciliation hid host authority denial
findings.evidence: A proven persisted PID returned an opaque reconcile_failed result when the Codex host denied taskkill, leaving no classified reason and tempting a false tree-closure inference.
findings.required_outcome: Preserve the Codex host authority boundary, return bounded failure classification, retain the active cleanup-failed record on denial, and claim closure only after an admitted termination and liveness check.
findings.repair_evidence: Process recovery passed 119 tests. Admitted termination returns reaped/tree_closed=true; simulated host denial returns reconcile_failed/tree_closed=false and retains CLEANUP_FAILED custody.

findings.title: Failed group receipts omitted actionable output evidence
findings.evidence: Long group campaigns wrote only pass/exit/duration fields, forcing complete group reruns to discover which test failed.
findings.required_outcome: Retain bounded, secret-minimized failure evidence without copying raw assertion or environment output into durable receipts.
findings.repair_evidence: Group receipts now hash stdout/stderr, record byte counts, and retain at most 50 sanitized failing node IDs; tests prove assertion and stderr payload text are not persisted.

findings.title: Completion status builder failed when invoked as a direct script
findings.evidence: python scripts/build_completion_status.py failed with ModuleNotFoundError while python -m scripts.build_completion_status worked.
findings.required_outcome: Both documented Python entry styles resolve the repository runtime consistently.
findings.repair_evidence: Direct invocation now loads the same builder and writes the non-certifying projection; its expected exit code remains 2 while independent acceptance is pending.

findings.title: Operation health builder could not read the actual installed-VSIX receipt envelope
findings.evidence: The builder expected listener_health at the receipt root while installed certification stores the authoritative projection below host.listener_health, so Doctor could never receive current listener route evidence from a real smoke receipt.
findings.required_outcome: Accept the installed receipt envelope, derive route state and canonical extension lifecycle facts without hand-authored claims, and retain raw host limitations without strengthening them.
findings.repair_evidence: The builder now reads both direct unit fixtures and host-enveloped installed receipts, emits a four-route certifiable health snapshot plus an extension health claim, and Doctor reports coverage healthy and extension healthy against the exact smoke receipt.

confirmed_safe_boundaries.claim: External cybersecurity capabilities do not execute or self-authorize by discovery.
confirmed_safe_boundaries.evidence: Provider validation reports execution_enabled=false, provider_scripts_admitted=0, provider_scripts_executable=false, metadata_only=true, authority_granted=false.

confirmed_safe_boundaries.claim: Standard PX skill routing does not grant Microsoft, enterprise, preserved-user, or cybersecurity-provider authority.
confirmed_safe_boundaries.evidence: The PX-native broker defaults to px-standard and requires explicit domain grants; the external cybersecurity provider is a separate candidate-only catalog.

confirmed_safe_boundaries.claim: Current structure, release-hygiene, licensing, graph, recovery, and resource inspections are valid.
confirmed_safe_boundaries.evidence: Structure audit passed 15 categories and 21 required items; release and licensing audits returned valid; graph registry reports six valid artifacts; recovery is healthy; active managed resources and processes are zero.
